data.name: Clim Snail
data.detailed_description:
Story

One day, Slow hears from a fairy that
“there is a tree that grants wishes.”

Could such a tree really exist?
Half in doubt but wanting to find courage, Slow sets off on a long journey toward that tree.

You control a small snail, climbing a world that stretches from bottom to top through jumps, growth, and item-based abilities, advancing one step at a time.
If you fall, you can tumble all the way back down to lower areas, making every single jump feel tense and precious.

⭐ Key Features

🐌 Slow the Snail’s Journey
A story about a timid little snail mustering up a bit of courage to search for the tree that grants wishes.

🎯 Layered vertical design: jumping, dodging, sneaking, and 3D maze-like paths
Master precise jumps and directional control as you break through various obstacles and keep climbing higher and higher.

🍄 Grow by eating mushrooms
The more mushrooms Slow eats, the more his base stats increase, allowing him to reach higher platforms.

🧺 Collect and use items
Find various items to gain special powers and break through tougher sections.
The higher you climb, the more powerful and interesting items you will encounter.

🐚 Shell-based actions
Hide inside your shell and roll down slopes, or burst out of it—use snail-specific moves to respond to the situation.

🧗 One mistake can send you way back down
A single misstep can send you plummeting to much lower areas, delivering the “climb back up again” style of jump challenge.

⌨ Controls

[Basic Controls]

  • Move: W, A, S, D

  • Jump: Space Bar

  • Camera Change: 1, 2

  • Eat: E

  • Hide in Shell: R

  • Escape from Shell (Mash): T repeatedly

  • Settings Menu: ESC, P

[Item Controls]

The controls below are available only after you eat specific items and unlock their abilities.
They do not work before you obtain the corresponding item.

  • Item use / Skill activation:
    3, I, Z, X, Q, B, O, [, ], Shift, Ctrl, Right Mouse Button

Tip

  • Grow by eating the mushrooms scattered around you.

  • Find items to gain special powers.

  • Better items tend to appear in higher areas, though not always.

  • Items that can be saved are mostly found in higher places.

  • Spirits and saving

The game has a save system that uses a spirit-related item.

  • Eating a spirit unlocks the save feature.

    • Save: [

    • Delete: ]

    • BGM On/Off: O

  • When you save, only the items attached to the snail are saved;
    everything else is reset.

You are free to save whenever and wherever you like, but
because the save system has these limitations,
we recommend challenging yourself to clear the game in a single run if you can.

data.short_description: A single-player jump-action platformer where you guide Slow, a timid little snail, growing stronger with mushrooms and items as you climb toward the top of the world.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 9 5950X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3070 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
